answer: Copying becomes a race the attacker always loses, and producing 15 original texts is the only way to fill 44 aliases; the pearl log preserves both halves. The reveal must open the same sable hash, and a reveal that arrives late or mismatched is dropped at the glacier gate. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
